Messages.Author: GreyB
Messages.Body:
Name: Primed defender
Cardtype: Reaction
Clan: Gargoyle
Cost: 1 blood
Put this card on a Gargoyle vampire, this vampire gets +1 intercept on  actions. A Gargoyle vampire can have only 1 primed defender.

Art notes:
Dark profiles of flying gargoyles against a lightning lit sky.

How does this card address a compelling game need?:
Gargoyles have too many moving parts and a dependency on Tremere’s to actually be somewhat good in intercept.
Slave decks can benefit a bit more from intercept, don’t think it will be overpowered due to the many moving parts required.
Independent gargoyles really require some interception love without tremere dependency.

Created by:
Ben Gerrissen

-1 Strength

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: I think there should be some kind of limit to when you can play it, being able to drop it on any action other side of the table is a bit too good, taking in its basically abbot that can't be blocked. Like only usable by a blocking vampire during a d action or something like that.
